CORRECTION_1_THE_ALIGNMENT_ARGUMENT_WAS_.what_the_numbers_say: the daughter's constituent-removal count is exposure-limited. With lambda_w = muY x daughter particle-steps, the exposure model predicts 5.809 COMPLETE worlds among those that saw a birth, against 5 observed under the probe. lambda runs 0.0608 to 1.2684, mean 0.3834, so P(no removal) is about 0.68 per world by physics alone.

CORRECTION_2_THE_PROBE_IS_A_LOWER_BOUNDI.corrected_statement: the frozen endpoint's step-t attribution is blind to most of the constituent removals the decay rate delivers. Re-attributing the identical ledger rows at step t-1 — a LOWER-BOUNDING PROXY for a pre-decay configuration the archive does not store — raises the count from 1 to 8 and recovers 7 previously unattributed. It raises the measured COMPLETE rate from 1/22 to 5/22 and the FUNCTIONAL rate to at most 4/22. Seventeen of the 21 failures survive the repair, and they survive for a physical reason.
